text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock E, B, and D after gains felt satisfying, but I should not sell just to lock in a gain; past price moves do not predict what comes next.","I tend to judge each stock against its own average cost, but I should consider my whole portfolio and make decisions based on what I believe about future risk and return.","Checking prices often can tempt me to trade for emotional reasons. I should pause before acting and remember that a small monthly move need not call for a trade."]}
